title: [Kogan First] GTA VI PreOrder $119 - Free Shipping - PS5 and Xbox
body:

[dowhatuwant2] Isn't Kogan first one of those lottery scams these days ?
[QuickToThePointless] prob best price you will get if you can wrangle the 7 days free trial…should work if you havent used it for a few years or sign up under new email/mobile
[Catsmagic] Stack with AMEX or Westpac $10 off $50 spend and APPLOVE code - managed to get for $104
[Brick50] That will likely be the cheapest, I was going to get it from Everyday Market when they have 30% off
[bozaar] Cant you buy $50 GC with the Amex and Westpac, making it $20 off?

[Agileduck] But would it arrive before Thursday and then you have to download it
[MrZ] I was getting 60fps on Quake 2 on PC back in 1997 lol
[Wiadro] It’s gunna be trash at 30fps
I haven’t played at 30fps since like monster truck madness 2
[Pinchy] Rockstar games always play great anyway at lower frame rates
[DingoBilly] It is crazy to me people are spending so much for a digital copy.
Like they'll call out AI slop, Ubisoft pumping out game after game, Blizzard being greedy with MTX etc. But then when Rockstar is establishing some shitty new practice they're all racing for it.
Boggles the mind.
